**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapters *Hodgkin & Non-Hodgkin Lymphomas,* pages 304-310.

**Note 2:** In addition to directly assigning Clinical and Pathologic Stage Group, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Hodgkin & Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma of All Sites* chapter on page 284 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=284).
